kyoto_gion_coffee_nanafuku.gf_detail: Ask. Coffee and soft serve alongside hot sandwiches, a cat-shaped French toast and sweets; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_coffee_nanafuku.vegan_detail: Ask. Black coffee, cold brew and lemonade squash are plant-based, but lattes, soft serve and the food use dairy or egg; no plant-milk information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_coffee_nanafuku.hours_raw: Daily 7:30–18:30; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Takeaway (Tabelog). 15 seats over two floors — remove shoes for the tatami-style upper floor; blankets and a clean restroom (Tabelog; April–May 2026). Small dogs allowed on the ground floor, held on your lap (Tabelog). Cards and e-money (Suica, iD, QUICPay); no QR (Tabelog). English menu and English-speaking staff (April 2026). Glass-fronted shop just before Yasaka Shrine near the Gion intersection; about 8 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn (April 2026). Opened 8 February 2022 (Tabelog).
kyoto_gion_coffee_nanafuku.notes: [Coffee · Gion at Yasaka Shrine, open from 7:30] A small two-floor coffee shop just before Yasaka Shrine, open from 7:30 every day: light-roast single origins, a smooth cold brew, café latte and an espresso soft serve that one reviewer called a must, with hot sandwiches and a cat-shaped French toast. Take your shoes off for the upstairs seats by the window over the Gion crossing. Cheerful, English-speaking staff and lots of visitors from abroad; small dogs welcome on your lap downstairs.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a café opened 8 February 2022. Reviewers in 2026 describe cheerful staff greeting guests in English and Japanese, many foreign tourists, freshly roasted coffee, and a calm Japanese-modern interior with a tatami-style upper floor.
chef_bio.specialty: Cold brew; espresso soft serve; light-roast single origins.

anecdotes.text: "I ordered the Espresso Soft Serve, and it was incredibly delicious—a hit menu after a long time." — July 2026, on the night of the Gion Festival.
An April 2026 visitor noted English menus and English-speaking staff, and was greeted with a smiling "Good morning".
"Being in the heart of a tourist area, I thought the taste might be secondary, but I was pleasantly surprised by the deep flavor and mild acidity" — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カフェ、東山区祇園町南側540-2、毎日 7:30〜18:30、予約不可、テイクアウト、15席、座敷あり、小型犬は1階で抱っこなら可、カード・電子マネー可、QR 不可、子ども可、2022年2月8日オープン。口コミ (2026年4月〜10月、英語): 八坂神社の手前、祇園の交差点、グアテマラとエチオピアの浅煎り、水出しコーヒー、カフェラテ、カフェオレ、エスプレッソのソフトクリーム、ホットサンド、猫の形のフレンチトースト、レモンスカッシュは甘め、英語のメニューと英語のスタッフ、海外の客が多い、2階は靴を脱ぐ。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu and English-speaking staff (April 2026); shoes off upstairs; small dogs on your lap downstairs.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_cafe_kocsi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a bread café — lunch sets come with all-you-can-eat bread, plus quiche, croutons and baked goods (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_cafe_kocsi.vegan_detail: Ask. A daily soup (e.g. pumpkin, mushroom) and salad come with the bread, but the quiche, pâté and many breads use egg, dairy or meat; no vegan information (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_cafe_kocsi.hours_raw: Monday, Tuesday, Friday, Saturday and Sunday 12:00–18:00; closed Wednesday and Thursday; lunch 12:00–15:00 on weekdays only; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog); a short queue on the stairs at opening at weekends (September 2025; October 2026). Order at the table, pay at the counter (September 2025). 20 seats with counter and sofa seating; non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog). Cards (Tabelog). Takeaway (Tabelog). Second floor of 黄瀬ビル, near Kyoto City Hall; 5 min walk from Karasuma Oike or Shiyakusho-mae stations (Tabelog; October 2025). Opened 11 November 2000 (Tabelog); reopened by September 2026 after a pause (September 2026).
kyoto_cafe_kocsi.notes: [Bread café · near City Hall, all the bread you want] A cosy second-floor café near City Hall, open since 2000 and sister to the popular bakery Année, where lunch means soup of the day, quiche or pâté with salad and refills of dense house bread — about ¥900–2,000. Books, sofas and an old-house feel; one guest found the back counter seats warm on a hot day. Short queues at weekend opening. Lunch on weekdays only. Closed Wednesday and Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: opened 11 November 2000. Reviewers describe it as the sister café of the bakery Année, which opened in 2014 west of Karasuma Oike (October 2025), guests being sent here from Année on a short day (September 2025; September 2026), small breads delivered from a nearby bakery (November 2025), and a reopening reported in September 2026.
chef_bio.specialty: Soup of the day with unlimited bread; quiche.

anecdotes.text: A September 2025 guest who found the sister store Année short of bread that day was directed here, ten minutes' walk away, and would gladly have eaten more of the unlimited bread.
A September 2026 regular came as soon as the reopening was announced and found "the interior and atmosphere are just as I remembered."
"I would have appreciated a few more varieties of bread in the all-you-can-eat selection." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: パン・カフェ、中京区福長町123 黄瀬ビル2F、烏丸御池駅・市役所前駅から徒歩5分、月・火・金・土・日 12:00〜18:00、水・木休み、平日のみランチ12:00〜15:00、予約不可、20席、禁煙、子ども可、カード可、テイクアウト、2000年11月11日オープン。口コミ (2025年9月〜2026年10月、英語): パン屋 Annéeの姉妹店、サラダとパン食べ放題のランチ、日替わりスープのセット900円、キッシュ、パテ、かぼちゃやきのこのスープ、ほうれん草のキッシュ、週末は開店時に階段に行列、2026年9月に再開、奥のカウンター席は暑かったとの声。

cultural_comfort.note: Second floor; order at the table, pay at the counter; cards accepted.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reopened, with reviews through October 2026.

kyoto_cave_de_k.gf_detail: Ask. A wine bar with a custard pancake, sandwiches, fritto and roast beef; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_cave_de_k.vegan_detail: Ask. Wine and champagne by the glass; the food named in reviews — cheese, fritto with shrimp and shirako, roast beef, custard pancake — is not vegan (2026 reviews).
kyoto_cave_de_k.hours_raw: 15:00–24:00; closed Tuesday; hours may change (Tabelog; official site). Reservations accepted — call ahead, as late hours fill (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). A ¥1,100 charge from 17:00 (Tabelog original 17時からはチャージ1100円; official site: 5:00pm〜 チャージ 1,100 yen); the official site also lists 税・サービス料 10%. 12 counter seats and a private room for up to 6, for guests who bring a bottle only; non-smoking; no children (Tabelog). Cards (Tabelog). English menu (Tabelog). Ground floor of ヴァルズビル on Nijo east of Kiyamachi, below Bar K6; 5 min walk from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Opened 24 March 2014 (Tabelog).
kyoto_cave_de_k.notes: [Wine bar · Nijo Kiyamachi, champagne by the glass and a famous pancake] A bright counter wine bar below Bar K6 on Nijo-dori, opening from 3 pm, where champagne and sparkling wine — Krug included — are poured by the glass from magnums, and the signature brûléed custard pancake is the sweet to order. Real dishes too: fritto, roast beef, soup, halved for solo guests. A ¥1,100 charge from 5 pm. Call ahead late at night. No children. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: opened 24 March 2014. Per the official site, part of K6 (ksix.jp), whose Bar K6 is upstairs. Reviewers in 2026 describe a calm, friendly owner who explains the wines, a ground floor for wine and an upstairs bar for whisky and spirits, and a theme of wine and desserts.
chef_bio.specialty: Champagne by the glass from magnums; custard pancake.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 guest was steered to a rare dessert wine to go with the pancake, and learned that sweet desserts can make lighter whites taste bitter.
A solo October 2026 diner, hesitating over dishes sized for two, was offered smaller portions of the fritto and roast beef.
Reviewers in August 2026 came down to Cave de K after finding Bar K6 upstairs fully booked — for one reviewer, the third time.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (K6): Cave de K、15:00〜0:00、火曜定休、税・サービス料10%、17時からチャージ1,100円。食べログ: ワインバー・パンケーキ、中京区木屋町二条東入ル ヴァルズビル1F、市役所前駅から5分、月・水〜日 15:00〜24:00、火曜休み、予約可、17時からはチャージ1100円、12席 (カウンター)、個室6名まで (ボトル持ち込みの客のみ)、禁煙、子ども不可、カード可、英語メニュー、2014年3月24日オープン。口コミ (2026年6月〜11月、英語): マグナムのシャンパーニュやスパークリングをグラスで、Krug のアンバサダーの店、名物のパンケーキ (ブリュレのようなカスタード)、じゃがいもと栗のポタージュ990円、フリット2,430円、ローストビーフ2,200円、少なめにもできる、2階は Bar K6、夜遅くは満席が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); ¥1,100 charge from 17:00; call ahead late; no children.

existence.note: Official site and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through November 2026.

kyoto_kotoshieru_granvia.gf_detail: Ask. French and Italian courses with pasta, bread (focaccia, baguette), butter sauces and desserts; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kotoshieru_granvia.vegan_detail: Not vegan: set courses of fish, abalone, duck and beef, with butter sauces and dairy desserts (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kotoshieru_granvia.hours_raw: Tuesday to Sunday and holidays 11:30–15:30 (last order 14:30) and 17:30–22:00 (last order 21:00); closed Monday except holidays (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; private hire by phone (Tabelog); queues at opening for lunch (September 2026). 15% service charge (Tabelog original サービス料15％). Dress code smart casual — men are asked not to wear sleeveless shirts or sandals; discounts and promotions not applicable (Tabelog). Lunch course ¥5,500 (October 2026); a ¥10,000 Tabelog course with champagne and wines (October 2026). A dessert-plate message for ¥500 (October 2026). 42 seats plus a 16-seat salon; private room "Grace Salon" for 6–16 from ¥16,800 courses; wheelchair accessible; non-smoking (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR incl. Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 15th floor of Hotel Granvia Kyoto in the Kyoto Station building, directly connected to JR Kyoto Station (Tabelog; October 2026).
kyoto_kotoshieru_granvia.notes: [French-Italian · Kyoto Station, Hotel Granvia 15F with a view] The Hotel Granvia Kyoto's top-floor restaurant above Kyoto Station, with wide windows over the city and monthly French-Italian courses: a ¥5,500 lunch of appetiser, soup or pasta, a main and dessert, or dinners with abalone pasta, duck and beef fillet. Attentive service that will time courses to your Shinkansen; one October 2026 diner found the food somewhat average for the price. 15% service; smart casual. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: The restaurant of Hotel Granvia Kyoto, on the 15th floor of the Kyoto Station building (2026 reviews; Tabelog address). Reviewers in 2026 describe attentive, well-timed service, monthly-changing menus and the view of Kyoto from the large windows.
chef_bio.specialty: Monthly course with a view; Genovese pasta.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 diner on the ¥10,000 Tabelog course found the food "somewhat average" against high expectations, but the service outstanding — timed around a Shinkansen departure.
"I got a bit lost trying to find this place since the address on Tabelog doesn't mention that it's above Granvia." — October 2026.
A September 2026 couple were moved to a window seat, which delighted the companion.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: フレンチ・イタリアン、下京区烏丸通塩小路下ル東塩小路町901 京都駅ビル、JR京都駅直結、火〜日・祝 11:30〜15:30 (L.O.14:30)・17:30〜22:00 (L.O.21:00)、月曜休み (祝日は営業)、予約可、サービス料15%、ドレスコードはスマートカジュアル (男性のノースリーブ・サンダル不可)、割引不可、42席とサロン16席、個室「グレースサロン」(6〜16名、16,800円〜)、車椅子可、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 可。口コミ (2026年9月〜10月、英語): ホテルグランヴィア京都の15階、京都の眺め、月替わり、ランチコース5,500円、食べログのコース10,000円、鯛のバターソース、九条ねぎとあおりいかのジェノベーゼ、鴨、鮑のパスタ、牛フィレ、フォカッチャとバゲット、メッセージプレート500円、新幹線の時間に合わせてくれた、料理はやや普通との声。

cultural_comfort.note: Smart casual; 15% service; book ahead; cards, e-money and QR.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.
